solutionSql:
SELECT s.id, s.weight_kg
FROM shipments AS s
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 60
  AND s.status = 'queued'
  AND s.weight_kg > (
    SELECT AVG(q.weight_kg)
    FROM shipments AS q
    WHERE q.status = 'queued'
  )
ORDER BY s.id;

ambiguities.phrase: greater than the average weight_kg of the queued shipments only (status queued)
ambiguities.readingChosen: Average over all queued shipments in the table (1001.0). The ids 1 to 60 limit applies to the rows returned.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Average over queued shipments with ids 1 to 60 only (about 1124.3). Measured: 7 rows, dropping id 38 (1010 kg).

notes: Shipment 38 (1010 kg) clears the table-wide queued average of 1001.0 by 9 kg, so the average scope decides whether that row appears.
